grants_spells._notes: Divine Magic (1st level, Xanathar's Guide to Everything) does two things: (a) any normal sorcerer known-spell pick can be taken from the Cleric list instead of the Sorcerer list — those still count against the normal known-spell total; (b) separately, choosing an affinity grants ONE additional fixed spell that does NOT count against spells known, chosen once at 1st level and fixed forever.
